note: Source URLs for every Higgsfield-generated asset. Run scripts/fetch-assets.sh to download these into assets/ for a fully self-contained, offline site.
video_model: seedance1_5 (Seedance 1.5 Pro, Bytedance) - 7 scenes x 4s, 16:9, 720p, silent; edited into one film with ffmpeg

hero.role: Anchor image. Defines the brand world; used as hero poster and as the video's start+end frame.

serum.role: Radiance Renewal Serum - floating bottle with liquid ribbon.

cream.role: Velvet Barrier Cream - jar on stone.

elixir.role: Midnight Repair Elixir - dark emerald composition. v2: v1 rejected in QC for a 112px white pillarbox border.

lineup.role: Full three-product lineup - editorial campaign band.

cap.role: Macro of the brushed muted-gold cap, knurling and sage ring.

botanical.role: Botanical light and shadow across ivory.

droplet.role: Macro serum droplet on optical glass.

reflect.role: Bottle mirrored in still water over ivory stone.

shelf.role: All three products on a floating ivory stone shelf.

poster.role: Frame 0 of the graded hero film. Video poster and reduced-motion still.

hero.role: Multi-scene hero film, 7 cinematic scenes joined with 0.75s dissolves. No baked text.

hero_mobile.role: Narrow-viewport hero variant, selected at runtime below 900px.

campaign.role: Same film plus a 2.6s AURELIA SKIN LAB wordmark end card (Cormorant Garamond). Click-to-play.

qc.method: Objective sandbox analysis (Pillow): palette conformance, hue histogram, pink contamination, luminance distribution, uniform-border detection, subject centroid. Visual inspection was not possible - the CDN is blocked by this environment's egress policy.

rejected.reason: 112px / 110px white pillarbox bars on left and right edges

scenes: 2 - macro brushed-gold cap, rack focus along the knurling
3 - floating bottle, serum ribbon and orbiting droplets
5 - mirror reflection in still water, single ripple
6 - botanical light and shadow drifting across ivory
7 - final hero, settles onto the opening frame
film_edit.transitions: 0.75s cross-dissolves between every scene (6 total). No wipes, no template transitions.
film_edit.grade: Per-scene brightness offsets closing a 0.058 luminance spread, plus unified contrast 1.04 / saturation 0.99.
film_edit.loop: Scene 7 ends on the same anchor frame scene 1 opens on, so the HTML loop point is seamless.
film_edit.qc: All 7 clips: 1280x720, 24fps, 4.04s, zero unintended hard cuts. Cross-scene pink <= 0.14%.
